blocks.x: Bordereaux automation and settlement evidence — reconciliation effort down 74%

A European specialty reinsurer — a Insurance & Risk engagement delivered by a blended Achala IT Solutions team under the outcome-linked engagement model. Identity withheld as standard; the figures are the client's, reproduced with permission.
Ceded bordereaux arrived in 30+ formats; reconciliation consumed a 12-analyst team quarterly.
Treaty settlement disputes rested on bilateral numbers; evidence chains procedural. Retro capacity optimization stopped early at solver ceilings.

We built the bordereaux engine on Forge (format normalization, auto-reconciliation with quality scoring), deployed a permissioned settlement-evidence network on Ledger between cedant, broker and reinsurer, and benchmarked retro capacity formulations in a Quanta tournament — the hybrid winner industrialized as a re-solve service.
